input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control, and an officer of Licensee shall certify in writing that Licensee as complied with the provisions of this Section. All of the Licensor's rights under this Agreement shall survive termination of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no transition-assistance or data-return provision anywhere. Article XXI (Effect of Termination, p0138) is entirely one-directional: the licenses terminate immediately and Licensee must ship all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information back to Licensor within five days with officer certification, while "All of the Licensor's rights under this Agreement shall survive termination." Nothing obliges Licensor to help us migrate or to return our own data. Article X confidentiality (p0124) binds only Licensee and contains no return/destruction mechanic that could serve, and the only other termination articles (XIX insolvency p0132-33, XX change of control p0134-37, XXIII p0142) are silent. This matters because the Licensed Technology is a hosted platform through which we receive market data and enter trading tickets (p0033, p0021), so our order, trade and account records sit on Licensor's systems; on termination we would have no contractual right to recover them, which falls at or near the walk-away position (no data return). We therefore insert the preferred position at p0138 as a new subsection (c): up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter; 90 days of assistance with the 30-day export is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor property; it gives us no exit path and no right to recover our own trade and account data held on the Licensed Technology. We have added a reciprocal provision giving up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback provided the 30-day data return stays.

ops.text: Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee data, trade, order and account records and other Licensee information in Licensor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data, records and information from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Licensee.
